rubric.evidence: Verified directly against W3C Digital Credentials §7.5-7.7 & §9, Blink credential_creation_options.idl, digital_credential_creation_options.idl, digital_credential.idl, digital_identity_credential.cc (openid4vci & openid4vci-v1 allowlist, exact rejection order), permissions_policy_features.json5, runtime_enabled_features.json5 (WebIdentityDigitalCredentialsCreation status: stable), BCD, webstatus.dev, and ChromeStatus 5099333963874304 on 2026-11-27.

Feature 5099333963874304 is listed under 'Enabled by default' in /api/v0/features?milestone=155 with exact listing name 'Digital Credentials API (issuance support)'; slug digital-credentials-api-issuance-support matches slugify(); H1 matches listing name; declared ChromeStatus table row links https://chromestatus.com/feature/5099333963874304.

Full reference covers all 9 inventoried surfaces (CredentialCreationOptions.digital, DigitalCredentialCreationOptions.requests, DigitalCredentialCreateRequest.protocol/data, DigitalCredential.protocol/data/userAgentAllowsProtocol()/toJSON(), and digital-credentials-create Permissions Policy) across all 9 reference-contract dimensions.

Clearly separates Chrome 155 issuance from Chrome 141 presentation, explains Android CredMan vs. desktop CTAP transport, details the exact Blink validation order (signal -> origin -> policy -> protocol filter -> user activation -> JSON serialization -> concurrency), and notes anti-fingerprinting guarantees for userAgentAllowsProtocol().

Provides complete OpenID4VCI issuance snippet with protocol detection, AbortController timeout, and toJSON() handling plus HTTP/iframe Permissions-Policy delegation examples, alongside links to all 3 verified HTTP-200 Chrome Platform Showcase concept demos.

Honest Limited availability banner and tabular compat matrix separating Chrome 155 issuance support from Chrome 141 / Safari 26 presentation support, disclosing BCD lag, Firefox negative position, and WebView/iOS non-support.
Every visible source and citation label carries a direct external <a href> with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; CPS feature root and all 3 concept demos HEAD-checked HTTP 200 on 2026-11-27.

Single <main>, single <h1>, sequential h2/h3 hierarchy, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, captioned tables with <th scope='col|row'>, focusable .table-wrap scroll regions and <pre tabindex='0'>, and visible :focus-visible outline.

Uses shared /public/styles.css editorial tokens, logical max-inline-size sizing, and horizontally scrollable .table-wrap containers without document horizontal overflow on mobile 360x740 or desktop 1280x800.

Links to https://chrome-platform-showcase.kinlan-test.workers.dev/v143/digital-credentials-api-issuance-support/ (and 3 concept demos, all HTTP 200; CPS conformance.json declares chromestatusId 5099333963874304). Intentionally not iframed because issuance requires digital-credentials-create Permissions Policy and transient activation and CPS hosts the suite under v143.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible semantic HTML landmark navigation code blocks iframe embed
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use a single <main> landmark, single <h1>, sequential heading hierarchy, semantic <header>/<nav>/<footer> landmarks, and <pre tabindex='0'><code> for keyboard-accessible scrollable code blocks.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: structured article with single <main>, <header class='lede-block'>, <nav class='local-nav' aria-label='On this page'>, <footer class='byline'>, sequential h2/h3 headings, and <pre tabindex='0'><code> on every code block.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation table scroll focus keyboard navigation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Provide keyboard-focusable scrollable containers with explicit region labels and visible :focus-visible rings for wide data tables so keyboard users can scroll without horizontal document overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: wrapped every .doc-table in <div class='table-wrap' tabindex='0' role='region'> with aria-label or aria-labelledby and a 3px var(--accent-blue) :focus-visible outline.

openQuestions: Track updates to Blink's kIssuanceProtocols allowlist (crbug.com/521181022) and BCD api/CredentialsContainer.json / http/headers/Permissions-Policy.json for digital-credentials-create.

followUpGoals.goal: Refresh Browser compatibility once BCD adds digital-credentials-create and CredentialsContainer.create({ digital }) entries or Safari ships issuance support.
